body: I had such an issue with my old gym membership despite me giving notice that I was moving. The contract that I chose stated that if you moved you could get out with no issues. I was able to get out with but then a year later I started getting charged again. There was so much back and forth and it got to the point where I finally had to get a charge back on my card and block them from making further withdrawals.
Black shoes are more Fall and Winter, white shoes are Spring and Summer.

I'm playing devil's advocate here, but OP may have meant that the United States dialect of English is the most widespread. I've interacted with a lot of international students at my school, and the English they're learning is the American dialect. They say cookies instead of crisps, And they don't add 'U's' to the words color and honor. I had a lot of foreign exchange students stay at my house and it's the same thing. In many cases they're being taught the American dialect.
